liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Stella Blue** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls the Space into Stella Blue sequence dreamy and a highlight; Stella Blue emerging from Space sounds pristine [13][24]
- **Row Jimmy** (1 review): Reviewer finds Row Jimmy especially sweet [20]
- **Terrapin Station** (1 review): Reviewer considers the stretch from Terrapin Station through Around and Around a keeper, with the band inspired [14]
- **Truckin'** (1 review): Garcia steers the band into a short Nobody's Fault But Mine jam in the last minute of Truckin' [17]
- **Around and Around** (1 review): Reviewer hears this Around and Around as among the hottest, rockingest versions they know [13]
- Reviewer singles out the extended jam coming out of Let It Grow as a highlight [13]
- Rare second-set Let It Grow placed after Terrapin Station, running about 22 minutes [18]
- Reviewer hears one section of Let It Grow that sounds just like ELP [22]
- Let It Grow is a drawn-out, surprisingly mellow, gorgeous journey [24]

## The recordings

- **gd79-09-02.rolfe.munder.10364.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 20 songs; 178 min; rated 4.12/5 by 16 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer rates this audience tape C quality, recommended for die-hards only; Reviewer finds the audience recording better than earlier reviewers claimed; Reviewer finds the audience recording sound okay but not great [18][19][20]
- **gd1979-09-02.145183.fob.nak700.wagner.miller.sirmick.flac1644**: source not stated; 21 songs; 184 min [2]. Said about its sound: The recording is mono because of a bad microphone cable; tracks are pitch corrected and hum removed from Row Jimmy [2]
- **gd1979-09-02.sbd.miller.93011.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 21 songs; 161 min; rated 4.38/5 by 21 [5]. Said about its sound: This soundboard is a huge improvement in source quality over earlier circulating versions [24]
- **gd1979-09-02.147685.mtx.seamons.ht117.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 174 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [6]. Said about its sound: The matrix mix evens out during Jack Straw [6]

## Around the show

- Reviewer's second show: fans on the hillock sought acid until a white box truck arrived with fresh unprinted blotter [15]
- Audience was tuned in, clapping on the beat during the second Jack Straw jam and at the start of Around and Around [16]
- Rowdy crowd of hopped-up New Englanders letting loose [17]
- Reviewer calls it the first Maine show for the band, with a small crowd of New England heads on the hill [19]
- Reviewer praises the Augusta Civic Center as a quaint, top-notch indoor room, at the start of the fall tour [20]
- Reviewer says that on a soundboard this Jack Straw might have outdone the one on 11.6.79 as 1979's hottest [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd79-09-02.rolfe.munder.10364.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording [1]. Also: Audience recording transferred from master cassette to DAT to CDR, via Paul B and seeded to etree by Willy [1]
- **gd1979-09-02.145183.fob.nak700.wagner.miller.sirmick.flac1644**: taped by Bob Wagner; transferred by Sirmick and Charlie Miller; source: (FOB) Nakamichi 700 > Sony TC-D5M > Cassette Master (Maxell UDXL-II) - Recorded by Bob Wagner [2]
- **gd1979-09-02.sbd.miller.93011.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Reel -> Dat (48k) [5]. Also: Nakamichi 700 cassette master through DAT to CD supplies fill-in sections of Let It Grow and Around and Around [5]
- **gd1979-09-02.147685.mtx.seamons.ht117.flac16**: source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons [6]. Also: Song breaks mostly preserved from Rolfe's audience tape; U.S. Blues comes from the audience source alone [6]

## Art and photos

- Poster by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1979-09-02 Sun Augusta Civic Center, Augusta, ME](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1405480866470/grateful-dead-1979-09-02-sun-augusta) [28]
